description: This file implements the egl::Config class and related classes/functions for managing graphics surface configurations, including attributes like color formats, buffer sizes, and rendering options within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Represents a graphics surface configuration with attributes like color format, buffer sizes, and rendering options.

classes.name: ConfigSet
classes.description: Manages a collection of Config objects, allowing addition, retrieval, and filtering based on attributes.

classes.name: ConfigSorter
classes.description: A comparator class used to sort Config objects according to EGL specifications and requested attributes.

methods.name: ConfigSet::add
methods.description: Adds a Config to the set, assigning it a unique ID.

methods.name: ConfigSet::get
methods.description: Retrieves a Config by its ID.

methods.name: ConfigSet::clear
methods.description: Clears all Configs from the set.

methods.name: ConfigSet::size
methods.description: Returns the number of Configs in the set.

methods.name: ConfigSet::contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific Config pointer exists in the set.

methods.name: ConfigSet::filter
methods.description: Filters Configs based on specified attribute criteria, returning sorted results.
